notes: Construction launch announced 2026-05-13: RMB2bn, ~28,000 sqm south of Xinglong Lake, will provide 3,600P intelligent computing for AI training/large models; completion expected 2027; China Telecom core western-region node and key expansion of Chengdu Tianfu cluster. MW not disclosed.

name: Tianfu Data Center Cluster (Chengdu-Chongqing hub)

notes: NDRC reply (Feb 2022) approving Chengdu-Chongqing as national hub node with the Tianfu Data Center Cluster (starting zones: Shuangliu, Pidu, Jianyang + Chongqing cluster); cluster-level designation under which individual Chengdu projects are built. MW not applicable at cluster level.

name: China Western Information Center (China Telecom)
developer: China Telecom (Sichuan)
notes: Data Center Map: China Western Information Center in new Tianfu area of Chengdu High-tech Zone; 60,030 sqm site, ~220,000 sqm building area incl. 30,000 sqm IDC space; China Telecom's flagship western-region facility. Aggregate directory source; MW not disclosed.

name: Tianfu Intelligent Computing Center Phase 4 (Chengdu Data Group)
developer: Chengdu Data Group
notes: July 2026 pre-bid announcement for compute-service procurement (~RMB300m) for Tianfu Intelligent Computing Center Phase 4 (following a RMB137m China Mobile Chuqu project earlier in 2026); indicates Chengdu Data Group's Tianfu intelligent-computing campus expanding to phase 4. Facility MW not disclosed.
